_refs: nitroForgeRef and nycTronRef are MOVING refs (branches), not release tags. A moving ref means a consumer's URL serves whatever is on that branch today. Pinning to a release tag is the recommendation, but cutting a tag is the owner's call (decision 45). To pin: node tooling/registry/set-ref.mjs <nitroForgeRef> [nycTronRef]. That rewrites these two values and regenerates every generated file. nycTronRef must point at a ref where NYC-Tron's r/ exists.

nycTron._note: Derived from the NYC-Tron registry, not assumed. Every @nyc-tron item installs its files at targetPrefix + <export key> + extension (checked against NYC-Tron's built registry.json: 22 of 22 items Forge depends on). shadcn expands the leading '@components' with the consumer's components.json aliases.components ('@/components'), so a consumer imports <importPrefix><key>. importPrefix is computed in tooling/registry/lib.mjs as targetPrefix with '@components/' replaced by aliasRoots['@components/']. check-imports re-reads NYC-Tron's registry (--nyc-tron-registry) and fails if a Forge import does not land on a file that registry installs.

@nitro-forge/ignition.reason: Native host. shadcn copies files and cannot run nitrogen, pod install or CMake (decision 4).

@nitro-forge/studio-layout.reason: Private workspace package with no tarball. Distribution waits on the versioning scheme (decision 3).
